Watch match highlights
Sheffield United 1-1 Derby: Patrick Bamford strikes to hold 10-man Rams
Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Sheffield United and Derby County at Bramall Lane on Saturday; Patrick Bamford scores as Blades hit back after Dion Sanderson red card leaves Rams with 10 men.
Saturday 24 October 2026 14:50, UK
Patrick Bamford was injured in the act of scoring Sheffield United's equaliser in a 1-1 draw with struggling 10-man Derby.
Bobby Clark gave the visitors a first-half lead with Bamford levelling the scores late in the game, only to limp off amid the celebrations.
After a quiet start, the game burst into life around the half-hour mark with efforts on goal at either end.
Derby threatened when the ball fell to Clark following a cross from Joe Ward and his firm drive was well saved by Michael Cooper down to his right.
Carlton Morris then found himself through on goal and fired in a shot on target which was saved by Cooper with his legs.

United's first effort of note came from Kalvin Phillips, whose long-range strike forced a save from Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.
Derby took the lead in the 37th minute when Ryan Hedges, on the left-hand side of the area, saw his low shot come back off the near post and the ball fell to Clark, who fired into the net from inside the D.
Blades boss Chris Wilder made a double substitution shortly before the hour-mark, sending on Sydie Peck and Femi Sereki.
Ben Brereton Diaz put an effort off target for the hosts while Derby's Sammie Szmodics chested the ball down before volleying over.
The visitors were reduced to 10 men in the 66th minute when Dion Sanderson received a second booking following a clumsy challenge on Sereki.
After Romelle Donovan had an effort saved by Zetterstrom, the substitute played a key role in the equaliser.
The goal came in the 79th minute when Donovan delivered a probing cross to the far post and Bamford was on hand to bundle the ball over the line from close range. Bamford was injured in the process, however, after falling awkwardly and he had to be replaced.
Peck fired in a shot on target but it was straight at Zetterstrom who made a comfortable save.
Tyrese Campbell and fellow substitute Peck had chances to win it for the hosts in time added on.
Campbell saw his shot on the turn force a fine save from Zetterstrom, who turned the ball onto the bar and away, then Peck fired in a shot which the keeper was again equal to.
Donovan saw his shot comfortably saved and in the dying seconds of the game United skipper Japhet Tanganga put an effort straight at Zetterstrom.
The result means that Derby have won just once in their opening 12 games of the season.

שפילד יונייטד סיימה בתיקו 1-1 ביתי מול דרבי קאונטי באצטדיון ברמול ליין. המשחק סיפק מספר אירועים דרמטיים, כולל כרטיס אדום לחובת האורחים ופציעה של כובש השער המארח. דרבי עלתה ליתרון במחצית הראשונה בדקה ה-37, כאשר בובי קלארק השתלט על כדור חוזר לאחר בעיטה של ריאן הצ'ס לקורה ובעט פנימה מקרוב את שער היתרון של קבוצתו.

המחצית השנייה התאפיינה בלחץ של המארחים ובחילות מצד שני המאמנים. נקודת המפנה הגיעה בדקה ה-66, כאשר דיון סנדרסון מדרבי ספג כרטיס צהוב שני והורחק מהמגרש בגין עבירה גסה. יתרון המספרי אפשר لشפילד ללחוץ על שער יריבתה, ובדקה ה-79 המחליף רומל דונובן העביר כדור רוחב מדויק לקורה הרחוקה, משם פטריק באמפורד דחק מקרוב פנימה. עם זאת, באמפורד נפצע באורח לא נעים לאחר שנחת בתנוחה לא נוחה בעת כיבוש השער ונאלץ לנטוש את המגרש. בדق הסיום ניסו שתי הקבוצות להכריע את המשחק ללא הצלחה.
